description: Decode the input text into ordered [label, integer value] records. Preserve every occurrence.
source:
import configparser

def solve(x):
    cfg = configparser.ConfigParser()
    cfg.read_string(x)
    pairs = []
    for section in cfg.sections():
        label = cfg[section]['label']
        value = int(cfg[section].get('value', 0))
        pairs.append([label, value])
    return pairs
